title: Run-flat tires and related issues
summary: This topic mainly combines reactions to BMW using regular tires instead of run-flats with a separate set of comments about software, app, and reliability problems that happen to use the word "run."

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the switch from run-flat tires to regular tires and describe prior run-flat experiences unfavorably.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus mostly on software, app, charging, and general vehicle problems rather than a consistent complaint about run-flat tires themselves.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the absence of run-flats, lack of a spare, product availability, and several unrelated uses of the word "run" without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: The cluster mixes two unrelated subjects: tire type and unrelated software or reliability comments that include the word "run."
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a single clear sentiment pattern.
At least one negative example appears inconsistent with its wording, so the negative evidence is limited to the assigned labels provided.
